examples.title: Vertical activity list
examples.description: Set a bounded height for the native viewport. Wheel, touch and keyboard scrolling remain native.

examples.title: Both rails
examples.description: subtle remains the default fading overlay rail. dark uses a persistent solid rail.

examples.title: Horizontal content
examples.description: orientation=horizontal keeps wide content inside its own native viewport.

examples.title: Without arrow controls
examples.description: showControls=false hides only the arrow controls; the thumb and native scrolling remain.

examples.title: Scroll and select
examples.description: Buttons inside the viewport own their selection state. Scrollbar supplies scrolling rather than listbox selection.
